info.name: RP01 Backend API
info.description:
Authentication, RBAC, user management.

**Setup:** Import RP01.postman_environment.json, set base_url to http://localhost:8080/api.

Run **Login** first — it auto-stores access_token, refresh_token, user_id.

request.description: Verify the API is reachable. No auth required.

Create a new account. `full_name` is optional.

Returns `user` + `session` on success (201). Supabase may require email confirmation.

response.name: Register – 201 Created

request.description: Authenticate with email + password. On success the test script auto-stores `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and `user_id` in the environment.

response.name: Login – 200 OK

request.description: Exchange a refresh token for a fresh access + refresh token pair.

response.name: Refresh – 200 OK

request.description: Send a password-reset email. Optional `redirect_to` (URL) overrides the default reset link destination.

response.name: Forgot password – 200 OK

request.description: Change the authenticated user's password. Requires Bearer token. Password must be ≥8 characters.
Fetch the authenticated user's profile + permissions. Requires Bearer token.

request.description: Partially update a user. All fields optional. Requires `users:write` permission.

response.name: Update user – 200 OK

request.description: Set `is_active = false`. The account record remains in the database. Requires `users:delete` permission.
Permanently remove a user from both the profiles table and Supabase Auth. **Irreversible.** Requires `users:delete` permission.
Add a role to a user. `role_id` must be a valid UUID. Requires `roles:write` permission.
Revoke a role from a user. Requires `roles:write` permission.
Return all roles with their attached permissions. Requires `roles:read` permission.

response.name: List roles – 200 OK

request.description: Fetch a single role by UUID. Requires `roles:read` permission.
Create a new role. `name` must be unique (1-64 chars). Requires `roles:write` permission.
Partially update a role. All fields optional. Requires `roles:write` permission.
Delete a role. System roles (`is_system=true`) cannot be deleted. Requires `roles:delete` permission.
Add an existing permission to a role. `permission_id` must be a valid UUID. Requires `permissions:assign` permission.
Remove a permission from a role. Requires `permissions:assign` permission.
Return all permissions. Requires `permissions:read` permission. The test script auto-stores the first permission's id as `permission_id`.
